source_note: Compiled 2026-10-28. Station format: [name, lon, lat, status, coord_source]. status 'existing' = an operating station already exists at that site (terminal or transfer; the new line's own platform may still be under construction); 'planned' = new station under construction/planned. coord_source 'osm' = OSM station node; 'approx' = no OSM/wiki node, point interpolated along the line's OSM construction way by published cumulative km or nearest landmark (expect ~100-500 m error). Provisional names (가칭) follow namu.wiki/ko.wikipedia and may change before opening.

대장홍대선.note: 12 stations, numbers 100-111 from the EIA draft; non-transfer names are provisional (오정/고강/신월/강서구청/덕은/상암/성산 from press). Planned stations placed on the OSM construction way 1312368721 at namu.wiki cumulative km (way length 19.40 km = namu 홍대입구 19.4 km). 100정거장 is the 1.88 km westward extension in 부천대장 지구. 홍대입구 platform position still disputed (레드로드 vs 홍대입구역사거리); DMC 추가역 not in the plan. Opening target 2031.

서울 지하철 7호선.note: 석남~청라국제도시 10.767 km, 8 stations incl. 청라국제도시 (인천시). Names are namu.wiki provisional names (001~005-1정거장, station numbers 762-769). Placed on OSM construction way 660683478 at namu km (offset fixed so 청라국제도시 = 71.2 km). 정서진(005-1, 돔구장) may open later (2029) than the rest; overall opening delayed (2027 target slipping).

도봉산옥정선.note: 도봉산~장암~탑석~양주 고읍지구, 15.1 km single track; '3 stations new/improved' = 장암(개량), 탑석(신설, 의정부경전철 환승; OSM construction node), 고읍(가칭, terminus at the OSM way end, 양주 고읍지구; some sources call it 옥정). Opening target end-2027 (delay risk).

옥정포천선.note: 4 new stations (양주 1 + 포천 3): 옥정중앙(706), 소흘(705, 송우지구), 선단(704, 대진대 입구), 포천(703, 포천시청/군내면; depot beyond). Names provisional (namu.wiki). Starts at 고읍, the 도봉산옥정선 terminus (through-running; not yet operating). Positions are approx on OSM way 888864943 (옥정중앙 = 포천 - 15.3 km per namu; 소흘/선단 by landmark). Opening target Dec 2030.

대구산업선.note: 9 stations DS01-DS09 (ko.wikipedia). 서대구/계명대/설화명곡 are existing stations of other lines (대경선·경부선 / 대구2호선 / 대구1호선); new platforms deep underground except 서대구. Others placed approx on OSM construction ways 894467790-894467794 (달성군청/달성산단/테크노폴리스 from namu km values shifted so 설화명곡 matches; 서재세천·성서산단(호림동)·국가산단 by landmark). Completion target ~2030.

경전선.note: The ~5.2 km '경전선' construction piece (128.9885,35.1623 -> 129.0425,35.1610) is OSM ways 708835502/708835503/816387204/816387205 named 경전선 with stale opening_date=2022: it is the 사상~부전 section of the 부전~마산 복선전철 (부전마산선), from 사상 east to join the existing line at 가야 (freight yard, not a passenger stop) and on to 부전. No intermediate stations between 사상 and 부전. Partial opening (사상~부전 and 진례신호소~강서금호) set for 2027-04-01, so the game's 2030 default is too late.
